nodes.label: Ask Noor
nodes.description: Offline tour companion PWA for coffee farm visitors. Guests hear Noor's recorded stories with checked subtitles, ask questions, and leave feedback.

nodes.label: GR-1: Answers only from Noor's recordings
nodes.description: No text-generation call in guest app; matcher returns moment IDs only. Verified by code search and unit tests

nodes.label: GR-2: Guest confirms every match
nodes.description: Confirm card is only path from question to playback. Verified by e2e: no clip plays without Yes tap

nodes.label: GR-3: Below threshold, save, don't guess
nodes.description: Threshold calibrated on test set; fail-safe rate measured. Unit tests at threshold boundaries

nodes.label: GR-4: Safety questions go to a person
nodes.description: decideSafety() runs first; never stored. Multilingual tests in 4 languages

nodes.label: GR-5: People check content before guests see it
nodes.description: Pack builder excludes unchecked items in production. Test asserts gating

nodes.label: GR-6: Noor decides
nodes.description: Orders need confirmation; new answers need recording; texts need approval

nodes.label: GR-7: Privacy
nodes.description: Ingest redacts emails and phone numbers; RLS denies anonymous reads; no names collected

nodes.label: GR-8: Honest labels
nodes.description: Demo-mode labels for drafts, stand-ins, synthetic data. Listed in manifest labels

nodes.label: AskBox component
nodes.description: Guest types question; goes through decideSafety, e5 matcher, decide logic; outcomes: confirm, saved, or safety

nodes.label: ConfirmCard component
nodes.description: Shows best-matching moment with topic label; guest taps Yes to play or No to save

nodes.label: OrderSheet component
nodes.description: Shows pictures, quantities, totals; Noor confirms payment with 4-digit farm code

nodes.label: Player with WebVTT subtitles
nodes.description: Plays audio clip with checked subtitles; falls back to checked source script if translation unchecked

nodes.label: Pack size: 150 MB max (P0)
nodes.description: Side-loadable target; P1 target 50 MB with trimmed model

nodes.label: Latency: 800 ms question→outcome
nodes.description: Median on mid-range Android after warm-up; model first load ≤5 s

nodes.label: Visitor languages: en, de, nl, sv
nodes.description: Four chosen from Gambia tourism arrival data; drafts for de, nl, sv unchecked

nodes.label: JavaScript budget: 250 KB gzipped
nodes.description: Guest route excluding worker and model; Phase 0 measured 143.2 kB

nodes.label: G1: Guests understand Noor's story in their language
nodes.description: Measure: subtitles available in all chosen languages, all checked

nodes.label: G2: Guests get correct answers or honest 'not yet'
nodes.description: Measure: top-1 accuracy ≥85%, false confirmations ≤5%

nodes.label: G3: Noor learns what visitors value
nodes.description: Measure: monthly text from synced feedback; themes agree ≥80%

nodes.label: G4: Noor earns more
nodes.description: Measure: orders recorded and confirmed; product idea traced from questions

nodes.label: G5: Works where connectivity is weak
nodes.description: Measure: offline e2e passes; pack size and load time measured

nodes.label: Noor (primary user)
nodes.description: Coffee farmer; learns what visitors valued, asked, wished for via monthly SMS; decides what to record/change/sell

nodes.label: Guest (international visitor)
nodes.description: Has own smartphone; understands story in their language; asks questions; leaves feedback; buys coffee

nodes.label: Local guide
nodes.description: Bilingual; checks translations; handles safety questions; lends phone with pack to guests

nodes.label: Cooperative reviewer
nodes.description: Ondera Coffee Cooperative staff; reviews content checks, approves monthly text, rolls out to other farms

nodes.label: Offline Playwright e2e test
nodes.description: Proof that core tour works fully offline after one download; covers: download, play, ask (confirm/saved/safety), feedback, order

nodes.label: Guardrail tests
nodes.description: Unit and e2e tests proving each guardrail (8 rules) works as specified

nodes.label: World Bank 'Small AI for Development' Challenge
nodes.description: Track C: Tourism, Hack-Nation 7, October 3–4, 2026. Entry point for Ask Noor.

nodes.label: Monthly SMS summary
nodes.description: Checked template filled with counts, approved by reviewer, sent to Noor's phone
